name: io.github.asgerami/wrangl
title: Wrangl
description: Turn any REST API into MCP tools, from an OpenAPI spec, a Postman collection, or a base URL.

packageArguments.name: --spec
packageArguments.description: OpenAPI 3.x spec or Postman collection to serve: a URL or a file path

packageArguments.name: --base-url
packageArguments.description: Upstream API base URL, when the spec has none or you need a different one

environmentVariables.name: WRANGL_TOOL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: "discovery" serves the API through 3 tools that search, describe, and call its endpoints (best for large APIs); "endpoints" gives one tool per endpoint

environmentVariables.name: WRANGL_PIN
environmentVariables.description: With discovery mode, comma-separated globs for endpoints to also expose as direct tools, e.g. "issues_create,pulls_list"

environmentVariables.name: WRANGL_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token for APIs that use bearer authentication

environmentVariables.name: WRANGL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key for APIs that use an API key

environmentVariables.name: WRANGL_BASIC_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: user:password for APIs that use HTTP Basic authentication
